'''Djab Wurrung''' ('''Djabwurrung''', '''Tjapwurrung''', '''Chaap Wuurong, Djaara, Jaara''') is the extinct<ref>{{Cite book|title=Dialects of Western Kulin, Western Victoria: Yartwatjali, Tjapwurrung, Djadjawurrung|url=https://www.vcaa.vic.edu.au/documents/alcv/dialectsofwesternkulin-westernvictoria.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200123214739/https://www.vcaa.vic.edu.au/documents/alcv/dialectsofwesternkulin-westernvictoria.pdf|archive-date=2020-01-23|access-date=2026-04-19|last=Blake|first=Barry J.|date=2011|publisher=La Trobe University}}</ref> [[Aboriginal Australian language]] of the [[Djab Wurrung people]] of central [[Victoria, Australia|Victoria]].
